title: InSight: A Mobile Assistant Helping Visually Impaired People Navigate Unfamiliar Environment

problem.summary: Navigating unfamiliar outdoor environments is one of the most demanding everyday tasks for people with visual impairments (PVI).
statements: Navigating unfamiliar outdoor environments is one of the most demanding everyday tasks for people with visual impairments (PVI).
However, existing navigation systems cannot simultaneously satisfy the needs of informative perception and precise localization during navigation.
This paper explores the core navigation demands of PVI through a preliminary study.

background.summary: Despite these difficulties, traveling to unfamiliar places remains a part of daily life, and PVI express a strong desire to complete such travel by themselves rather than relying on sighted assistance (Jain, Teng, et al., 2023; Müller et al., 2022).

solution.summary: We first conducted a field observation session, in which we accompanied a visually impaired person as he navigated outdoors with BlindSquare.
